item.title: How to Install CouchDB Locally and Enable CORS
item.description: These days I’m doing all my development work on a Chromebook. Since the majority of my projects involve Apache’s CouchDB, I need a local instance up and running. In this tutorial, I’ll walk you through how to install CouchDB from a Ubuntu command line and enable CORS manually (by editing the config file).
